messages.subject: x-axis Problem
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am trying to plot a time-series, with percentages of some observations on the y-axis. The x-axis has dates which are just years. I am unable to control the breaks and the decimal places of the x-axis. I have this problem when the variable on the y-axis has values with decimal places. When the values are whole numbers, there is no issue.

Are there some suggestions on this? The graph is shown below.

Narasimha.

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: x-axis Problem
parts:
To control tick placement, you'll want to look at scale_x_continuous,
especially its 'breaks' setting. To format tick labels, I'd suggest
reading this: http://www.cookbook-r.com/Graphs/Axes_(ggplot2)/#tick-mark-label-text-formatters.

Finally, for more specific help, please provide a minimal reproducible example!

Ben
